option.bear.10.help: Choose a card from your Penalty zone and place it in another player's Penalty zone.
option.bear.11.help: When drawing cards, you may choose cards from your Penalty zone as well as from the River.
option.fox.20.help: When placing cards, you may place the final card underneath your personal pile.
option.fox.21.help:
When placing cards, you may place the final card face down underneath your visible Animal card.
During final scoring, it counts as an animal type of your choice.
option.moose.30.help: Increase or decrease your draw value by 1.
option.moose.31.help: Increase or decrease your placement value by 1.
option.orca.40.help: Immediately refill the River after each card you take.
option.orca.41.help: When drawing cards, you may take 1 or more face-down cards from the top of the common draw pile.
option.puffin.50.help: Before placing your cards, swap a card from your Hand with a card from the River.
option.puffin.51.help:
Before placing your cards, take your visible Animal card back into your hand. Careful, because you now have a new placement value this turn.
If you don't have a visible Animal card, your placement value is considered to be 1.
option.walrus.60.help: Move the token corresponding to the main animal 1 extra card in the direction of your choice.
option.walrus.61.help: Move the token corresponding to the companion animal 1 extra card in the direction of your choice.
